Attachment Style version 1.0.0 — Launch summary

- Initial release of the skill focused on identifying and explaining attachment styles (secure, anxious, avoidant, fearful-avoidant) in relationships.
- Enables assessment through behavioral questions and recognizes classic pairing dynamics and common relationship patterns.
- Offers targeted, actionable strategies for each attachment style, with brief explanations for why these develop.
- Includes safety notes to ensure attachment theory isn’t misused or confused with more serious relationship issues.
- Delivers concise, structured feedback using an easy-to-read response format.
